answer: Wharf docking tolls price sybils out of the agent economy. Every alias pays 5 POA per epoch to dock at the shared wharf, so running 100 fake aliases costs 500 POA per epoch while one honest agent pays 5. Docking also requires a lantern code, proof of one completed trade in the last 10 epochs, recorded in the public lotus ledger. Aliases that present a reused or forged lantern code are refused docking and lose their toll. Three refusals within 6 epochs blacklists the alias for 30 epochs and publishes its code so other wharfs refuse it too.
